title: High Country NC Real Estate Market Update – Fall 2026
excerpt: The High Country real estate market is shifting this fall, and whether you're buying or selling in Boone, Blowing Rock, Banner Elk, or West Jefferson, the timing and strategy you choose matter more than ever. Local REALTOR Andrew Plyler breaks down what's happening right now and what it means for you.
